parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json;if(x.stage!=='story_breakdown'||x.execution_status!=='passed')throw new Error('S2 final entry failed closed');return [{json:x}];

const x=$input.first().json,e=[],cit=x.source_packet.citation_inventory.map(c=>c.citation_id),disp=x.citation_dispositions.map(c=>c.citation_id),prd=x.prd_elements.map(p=>p.item_id),stories=x.epics.flatMap(ep=>ep.features).flatMap(f=>f.stories),mapped=stories.flatMap(s=>s.item_ids);if(cit.length!==disp.length||new Set(disp).size!==disp.length||cit.some(id=>!disp.includes(id)))e.push('citation disposition set');if(prd.length!==mapped.length||new Set(mapped).size!==mapped.length||prd.some(id=>!mapped.includes(id)))e.push('PRD delivery set');const known=new Set(cit);for(const s of stories)for(const id of s.citation_ids)if(!known.has(id))e.push('unknown story citation');if(e.length)throw new Error('S2 bidirectional validation failed: '+e.join('; '));return [{json:{...x,reconciliation:{source_documents:x.source_packet.source_manifest.length,citations_indexed:cit.length,citations_dispositioned:disp.length,prd_elements:prd.length,delivery_items:stories.length,orphan_citations:0,orphan_items:0,orphan_prd_elements:0,orphan_delivery_items:0}}}];
